title: [Feature Request] Lock/Hide OpenAPS SMB in config builder until Obj 9 has been completed
symptom: New users can select OpenAPS SMB in config builder from the beginning, even though SMBs are not yet possible, causing the algorithm to shut off basal during meal bolus window and guaranteeing post meal highs.
cause: The issue is that it's possible to select OpenAPS SMB from the very beginning in config builder even though SMB cannot be used yet, and it behaves differently from OpenAPS AMA.
evidence_quote: The issue is the it’s possible to select OpenAPS SMB from the very beginning in config builder (even though SMB cannot be used yet) and it behaves in different way to OpenAPS AMA.
